resources.string: Today\'s outlook, rain timing and umbrella advice for this area will appear here.
See the weather where you are
Daily Weather uses your approximate location to fetch the forecast for your area. It is checked only when you open the app or ask it to update, and is never tracked in the background.
Without location access the app can\'t find your local forecast. You can allow it whenever you\'re ready.
To see local weather, open Settings, go to Permissions → Location, and choose \"Allow only while using the app\".
Turn on location for your device, then come back to the app.
This can happen indoors or without a network connection. Please try again in a moment.
The week ahead will appear here once weather data is available.
Notifications, units, theme and location preferences will be configurable here.
